bluf: Consultwebs is a Raleigh, NC law firm only digital marketing agency founded in 1999 that sells SEO, AI SEO, ads, web design and video to small firms and claims clients average a 300% rise in signed cases. It is making the AI visibility move: a dedicated AI SEO page, a free AI visibility report, an llms.txt, 235 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days, and 3 of 3 house tests practised. The record shows no moves, news or jobs. The Monsoon read puts it at 63.3, Onshore wind, displacement 69.3: the SMB legal book buys on price, and an offshore rival undercuts its sold hours.
doing:
Consultwebs positions as a law firm only digital marketing agency with 25+ years, judged on signed cases, selling SEO, AI SEO, ads, web design and video: it markets small law firms, measured on cases signed rather than traffic. The headline claim is that clients average a 300% rise in signed cases; the record holds the claim with no case study behind that figure.

The sold mix has no single lead line; four lines score 2 and read as core. AI Search / GEO rests on a dedicated AI SEO page targeting ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and AI Overviews plus the free AI visibility report. Paid Search rests on case studies of Google Ads search campaigns, an 891% advertising return and a dedicated PPC case study page. SEO rests on the SEO nav item, an SEO for Lawyers guide and case studies including Spanish expansion and ROI by market. Web & Product rests on the Web Design nav, a law firm website design portfolio and website redesign case studies for Salvi and Marks & Harrison. Paid social, programmatic, content, creator and email score 1 with no evidence note; data and measurement, CRO, local and AI automation score 0. Proprietary lines are LawEval and the AI Visibility Tool for Law Firms; the record lists no partner badges. It runs the LAWsome Podcast and a legal marketing blog of 426 posts in the sitemap.

Its AI posture is a product: AI SEO for law firms aimed at ChatGPT, Gemini and AI Overviews, with the free AI visibility report as the door. The record lists no dated moves, no news, no jobs and no pricing signals. Conspicuously absent for a legal vertical agency of 25+ years: any local or Google Business Profile line, any measurement or call attribution service despite a CallTrackingMetrics tag on its own site, an employee count, ownership, and any statement of price.
clients:
The client type is SMB and the vertical is legal only; the home market is the US from Raleigh, NC, the one office listed. The needs read holds 11 clients, 7 with an observed need and 4 named only, from 8 case studies and 3 case study slugs. The mix leans on web build: 5 of the 11 came for web build and platform (Collins Law, The Levin Firm, Kornbluth Ginsberg Law Group, P.A. and Bayuk Pratt LLC from the website designer portfolio, and Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C. from a case study on how its website helped a family find justice). Paid performance shows for David Resnick & Associates P.C. (an 891% advertising return in 6 months) and The Barry Law Firm (Google Ads search campaigns and Facebook ads to get more cases, also coded organic demand and lead generation). Marks & Harrison (consistent growth since 2014) is coded named only, though the capability note counts it as a website redesign. Slug only names: The Jebaily Law Firm (every 1 spent got 7 back), Charles R. Ullman & Associates and Amourgis and Associates, Attorneys at Law, needs inferred from the sold mix.

One client is shared: The Levin Firm also sits on the book of rankings-io.

What the base needs next: small law firms sit under KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) and KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out), its Horus tailwind and headwind. It is very likely, moderate confidence, that these firms will ask what an AI answer says about them before they ask about rankings, which the free report is built to catch; it is likely, moderate confidence, that the same firms will press on price, given displacement 69.3 on the Monsoon read.
house: Say and do: three lines tested, three practised, integrity 100. AI search is corroborated: it publishes an llms.txt and its sitemap holds 12 AI topic URLs. Paid search is corroborated: it runs its own Google ads, 14 in the Transparency Center and 2 in the last 30 days, 13 text and 1 video, last shown 2026-09-27; the advertiser record names GOLDEN GLOBE INTERNATIONAL GROUP rather than Consultwebs. Publishing cadence is corroborated: the sitemap lists 1021 URLs, 235 updated in 90 days and 292 in 365. The Radar flagged no gaps. LinkedIn shows 0 ads (the note reads '0 ads match the name query (all advertisers); first results page shows 0 cards'), unflagged since paid social is not sold. No social pixels were detected on its WordPress site; the tag stack is GTM, HubSpot, Microsoft Clarity, Dealfront Leadfeeder and CallTrackingMetrics, with Dealfront Leadfeeder the one ABM tool and no test tools. It blocks no AI crawlers.
market:
Horus puts Consultwebs at tailwind index 4.3, band Neutral, 16:38 on the Solar Arc. Best placed for KJ1 (the click replaced by the citation, driven by AI Search / GEO). Most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle hollowed out, driven by Paid Search and SEO). Best scenario fit: The Toll Road at 42/100. It is making P1 (AI search at depth with a measurable AI visibility product), partial on P4 (paid media without first party data, creative volume or measurement depth) and P7 (some owned audience work), absent on P2, P6 and P8; P3 not applicable, P5 unknown.

The Monsoon read is 63.3, band Onshore wind, percentile 80: migration 57.3 and displacement 69.3, so clients leaving on price outweighs hours moving with the agency. The sold mix supplies 57 of the index, SEO (14) and Web & Product (14) carrying the most movable hours; the work would go 65% to South and Southeast Asia and 25% to Latin America, and automation overlaps 21%. Footprint inferred: no hub offices, no onshore claims, SMB client type adding 12 points.
openings:
The strongest opening is price: displacement 69.3 on the Monsoon read says the SMB legal book buys on price, SEO and web build carry the most movable hours, and an offshore delivered rival can very likely (moderate confidence) undercut the web design and SEO retainers for the portfolio firms whose only recorded need is a website. Falsifier: a Consultwebs pricing page or onshore delivery claim entering the record would weaken it.

The Levin Firm already sits on the book of rankings-io and is the account to contest first. Lead with the gaps in the sold mix rather than a contradiction, since its house practises 3 of 3 tested lines: local and data and measurement score 0 for a firm selling to law offices, and P3 is read as not applicable, so a rival pairing AI visibility with Google Business Profile work, call attribution and intake measurement offers what the record shows Consultwebs does not sell. No ads tested inside AI assistants (P8 absent), no feed, schema or entity work (P2 absent), no public pricing model (P5 unknown): an outcome priced offer built on signed cases meets its headline claim on its own terms.
watch: I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, late October 2026: growth below 10% flags cannibalization of the paid search line, above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and the KJ1 tailwind its AI SEO page sells into.
I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.

I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, October 2026: output or outcome pricing at a top five holdco would sharpen the KJ6 exposure of an agency judged on signed cases with no public price.
I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the $2B milestone and pricing below $20 CPM decide whether the KJ2 tailwind arrives while its P8 stays absent.
The Google ads last shown 2026-09-27 under GOLDEN GLOBE INTERNATIONAL GROUP: the next compile should show whether the advertiser name resolves to Consultwebs and whether any LinkedIn ads appear.
The next Radar compile: this dossier is only as fresh as the 2026-09-28 compile; the sitemap cadence of 235 URLs in 90 days is the figure most likely to move.
